validation_selection_note: Thresholds derived exclusively from the validation split (val_predictions.csv). 100 benign sessions + 1 VPN session. No test data used for threshold selection.
block_threshold_basis: max benign session score (zero block-FPR on val)
review_policy_description: The FLAG_REVIEW band [0.027090, 0.165365) acts as an uncertainty absorber. Under domain shift, benign traffic in unseen environments may produce elevated but unreliable scores. Instead of forcing a binary PASS/BLOCK decision, these flows are routed to a human analyst queue. This reduces risky automatic decisions when the model is operating outside its training distribution.

action_mapping.PASS: score < 0.027090  — Score below review threshold. Traffic consistent with benign baseline.
action_mapping.SIMULATED_BLOCK: score >= 0.165365  [SIMULATION ONLY — no real packet blocking]

explanation_templates.PASS: Score below review threshold. Traffic pattern consistent with benign baseline.
explanation_templates.FLAG_REVIEW: Score is uncertain; manual review recommended.
explanation_templates.SIMULATED_BLOCK: Score exceeds block threshold; simulated block recommendation. [SIMULATION ONLY — no real packet blocking.]

disclaimer: SIMULATION ONLY. No real packets are blocked. All SIMULATED_BLOCK decisions are audit/log events only. This prototype is not production-ready.
